title: Fix Add to Cart error and implement drag-and-drop product reordering with marketplace display order persistence

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the Add to Cart functionality error in ProductCard component (frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx) where clicking the 'Add to Basket' button fails with an error message. Verify the useAddToCart mutation hook implementation in useQueries.ts calls the correct backend addToCart method with proper parameters, handles authentication state correctly for both authenticated and guest users, and displays appropriate success/error toast notifications.

quotes: 1 it won't add the item to cart, error message

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Add to Basket' on ProductCard successfully adds the item to the shopping cart without error messages
Success toast notification displays when item is added to cart
Cart icon badge updates to reflect the new item count
Backend addToCart method is called with correct product ID and user principal
Error handling displays user-friendly error messages if the operation fails

requirements.text: Add a displayOrder numeric field to the Product type in backend/main.mo to store custom ordering position for products. Initialize displayOrder for all existing products with sequential values based on their current order, and ensure all new products receive a displayOrder value when created.
acceptanceCriteria: Product type includes displayOrder field as a Nat or Int type
All existing products have displayOrder values assigned during migration
New products receive appropriate displayOrder values when created via bulk upload or manual creation
displayOrder values are unique and sequential across all products

requirements.text: Update backend getProducts, getFeaturedProducts, getMostViewedProducts, getBestSellingProducts, and getNewestProducts methods in backend/main.mo to sort products by displayOrder field in ascending order as the default sort behavior when no other sorting criteria is specified, ensuring the marketplace storefront displays products in the order defined by drag-and-drop reordering.

quotes: it affect how products appear on the public Marketplace storefront

acceptanceCriteria: All product retrieval methods sort by displayOrder by default
Marketplace home page displays products in the custom order defined in the admin dashboard
Product sections (featured, most viewed, best selling, newest) respect displayOrder when displaying products
Reordering products in the dashboard immediately affects marketplace display order

requirements.text: Create a backend method updateProductDisplayOrder(productIds: [Text]) in backend/main.mo with admin authentication that accepts an array of product IDs in the desired display order and updates the displayOrder field for each product to match the new sequence. Implement efficient batch updating to handle reordering operations.
acceptanceCriteria: updateProductDisplayOrder method requires admin authentication
Method accepts an ordered array of product IDs
Each product's displayOrder field is updated to reflect its position in the array
Method handles errors gracefully if product IDs are invalid
Updates are atomic and complete successfully or roll back on failure

requirements.text: Create a React Query mutation hook useUpdateProductDisplayOrder in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that calls the backend updateProductDisplayOrder method with an ordered array of product IDs, includes admin authentication, and invalidates the product list cache after successful reordering.
acceptanceCriteria: useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation hook is available in useQueries.ts
Hook accepts an array of product IDs representing the new order
Successful mutation invalidates product list queries to refresh the display
Hook includes proper error handling and loading states
Toast notification displays success or error messages

requirements.text: Install and configure a drag-and-drop library (such as @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable) in the frontend to enable drag-and-drop functionality for product rows in the ProductManagementTable component.
acceptanceCriteria: Drag-and-drop library is installed as a frontend dependency
Library is properly imported and initialized in the ProductManagementTable component
Drag-and-drop functionality works smoothly on desktop browsers
Visual feedback indicates when an item is being dragged
Drop zones are clearly indicated during drag operations

requirements.text: Add drag-and-drop functionality to the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) allowing admin users to reorder products by dragging and dropping table rows. Enable drag-and-drop only when the 'All' shape filter is active (no shape filters applied). When products are reordered, call the useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation hook to persist the new order to the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Each product row in ProductManagementTable has a drag handle or is fully draggable
Drag-and-drop is enabled only when 'All' shape filter is selected
Drag-and-drop is disabled when any specific shape filter is active
Visual indicator shows that drag-and-drop is disabled when filters are applied
Dragging a row displays visual feedback showing the drag operation
Dropping a row at a new position immediately updates the table display
After dropping, useUpdateProductDisplayOrder mutation is called with the new order
Table displays products in the new order after successful backend update
Error messages display if the reorder operation fails

requirements.text: Add visual indicators to the ProductManagementTable component showing when drag-and-drop reordering is available versus when it is disabled due to active shape filters. Display a message or tooltip explaining that drag-and-drop reordering is only available when viewing all products without filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual indicator shows drag-and-drop is available when 'All' filter is active
Visual indicator shows drag-and-drop is disabled when shape filters are applied
Tooltip or help text explains the drag-and-drop availability conditions
Drag handles are visually distinct when enabled versus disabled
User understands why drag-and-drop is unavailable when filters are active

constraints: Drag-and-drop reordering must only be enabled when viewing all products (no shape filters active)
Product reordering must persist to the backend and affect marketplace display order
Add to Cart fix must work for both authenticated and guest users
Drag-and-drop must not interfere with existing checkbox selection and bulk editing features
Display order changes must immediately reflect on the public marketplace storefront
nonGoals: Drag-and-drop reordering within filtered views (only when viewing all products)
Reordering products within individual product sections on the marketplace page
Touch/mobile drag-and-drop support (desktop drag-and-drop is sufficient)
Changing the shape filter UI or filter behavior
Modifying the bulk editing checkbox system
